purpose: Maximize report evaluation score through rubric mapping and critical pre-authoring audits without post-hoc result seeking.

model_complexity_technique_sufficiency.finding: Complexity is a strength when framed as 69-technique outcome-blind research followed by structural reduction to six mechanisms, an eight-coefficient regularized model and one nonlinear challenger, appropriate to 75 OOS events / 54 date clusters.

economic_backtest_quality.finding: EXP-06/06R contain fixed PIT entry/exit, equal-notional sizing, SPY benchmark, 20/35-bps costs, multiplicity controls and event/trade-level economics. Do not invent standard financed-portfolio Sharpe or max drawdown because overlap-capital aggregation was not frozen.

event_universe_information_asymmetry.finding_so_far: Earnings/EPS has direct evidence of information heterogeneity and is exceptionally strong on resolution, direct equity mapping, sampleability and PIT reproducibility. It should not be called a low-asymmetry universe; the open question is whether another family dominates on the joint EUAS criteria.
